title: ICP Versus Intracranial Compliance Guided Management in SAH
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether treatment guided also by ICP mean wave amplitude improves outcome compared to international standard care in patients with SAH.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subarachnoid hemorrhage, acute
* Intracerebral pressure monitoring device inserted

Exclusion criteria:

* No intracranial pressure monitoring
* Age \< 18 years
